acceptance.given: The validator is invoked with explicit repository root, package root, policy, and mode inputs.

oracle.expected: The validator performs only local static inspection and produces its structured result without model or HTTP calls, package installation, new dependency services, or automatic execution of package-declared commands.
forbidden: A model is added or invoked.
An HTTP request is added or issued.
An installer or package installation is performed.
A new dependency service is added or started.
A package-declared command is automatically executed.
oracle.observable: The validator test observes the real validator entry and checks its execution boundary and structured result; no prohibited external or automatic execution event is observed.

acceptance.then: The validator remains local and static with no prohibited external or automatic execution behavior.
acceptance.when: Run the real validator test and inspect the resulting execution boundary and returned result.

failure_intents.selector_intent: The validator test observes a model or HTTP call, package installation, newly created dependency service, or automatic execution of a package-declared command.
The declared validator test command cannot invoke the real validator entry or cannot observe the required execution boundary.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Constrain package validation to local static inspection and prohibit model, HTTP, installer, dependency-service, and automatic package-command execution.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Revert the validator implementation change; no persistent state or schema migration is introduced.

slice_hint.state_transition: Validator behavior is established as bounded local static inspection with no external or automatic execution side effects.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The validator test passes for compliant local execution and fails when the implementation performs any prohibited external or automatic execution.
